scope: One-parameter, same-model, same-discretization, noise-free synthetic liquid-water recovery over original drying window only. No new forward mechanism or material validation.

calibration.tolerance.note: Optimizer stopping tolerance matched to approximate forward solver; first 1e-6 attempt reached evaluation cap despite <0.2% parameter error; no extra precision target.

calibration.difference_step.note: Finite-difference perturbation / synthetic recovery acceptance; numerical setting, not material evidence.

calibration.recovery_relative.note: Finite-difference perturbation / synthetic recovery acceptance; numerical setting, not material evidence.

calibration.binding.truth.note: Predeclared noise-free same-model single-parameter drying demonstration truth; not a measured or recommended material value. Other parameters are fixed.

calibration.binding.initial.note: Predeclared initial guess for the single-parameter liquid-water drying demonstration. Does not replace the nominal material parameter.

calibration.binding.observation_times.note: Predeclared elapsed simulation times for original-schedule drying-window synthetic liquid-water observations; not experimental sampling times.

calibration.scale.liquid_water.note: Fixed residual normalization scale for the synthetic liquid-water demonstration; not a measurement standard deviation or material uncertainty.

verification_scope.window: Original nominal 12cell/60s drying_ramp+drying only. No new full-cycle/refinement/UQ/second parameter.
verification_scope.fit: water.binding_energy alone, truth9000J/mol, initial12000J/mol, original bounds[0,20000]; all other material/process/numerical parameters fixed including Cp_binding5J/mol/K.
verification_scope.observation: Whole-domain condensed liquid mass / initial dry mass; six predeclared times; noise-free same-model and same-discretization synthetic data. scale1e-4kg/kg is residual normalization, not measurement uncertainty.
verification_scope.budget: Use existing max_nfev18, all tolerances and recovery relative2%; actual residual including difference calls recorded, plus one truth and one final readback. No extra precision or multistart; failure retained.
verification_scope.acceptance: Separate optimizer termination, physical window budget, local rank1, normalized RMSE, parameter relative recovery<root2%, and actual drying criterion. No global uniqueness or material claim.
verification_scope.evidence: No raw fields persisted. Dataset, summary, progress/final result and derived fitted parameters retained; root nominal untouched. Own initial U/S per parameter case; no added heat.
verification_scope.status: All fitted synthetic parameters retain assumed. Product and cooling outputs from truncated run not treated as applicable.

free_water_ledger.inventory_definition: Free water is liquid water plus pore-gas H2O; it is not total water-equivalent hydrogen including minerals or organics.
free_water_ledger.units: mol of H2O; signed changes over the reported interval
free_water_ledger.sign_convention: Reaction sources are positive into each inventory. Evaporation extent is positive liquid-to-vapor and negative for condensation. Boundary in/out are separately nonnegative; net outward is out minus in. Cell redistribution is positive for net liquid gain from internal faces; the liquid exterior is closed.
free_water_ledger.accounting_basis: Reaction extent differences and gas boundary in/out differences use existing solver-integrated ledgers. Cell liquid redistribution is inferred as liquid inventory change minus stoichiometric liquid reaction sources; it includes numerical inventory/extent mismatch and is not an independent flux-integral check.
free_water_ledger.reaction_source_note: Non-phase reaction water is taken from each existing reaction stoichiometry and signed extent; retention-site loss creates no separate water source. Internal liquid and gas transfers cancel in whole-domain water accounting.
